notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). The Steam schema calls app 424840 "ATLAS" (an internal codename); the store list confirms it as "Little Nightmares". Achievement descriptions are cryptic hints rather than plain conditions, so chapters are matched by achievement name: the five area chapters come from five achievements named after areas, and those area names also appear as page names on Fandom. 10 of 22 Steam achievements are hidden. They sit with five visible achievements that have riddle-like hints and unlock rates of 1.6% to 6% (Hard to the Core, So Close, Not Alone, End in Sight, Is Anybody Out There?) in one secrets chapter, because the data does not say where they happen. RAWG lists three related entries (The Depths, The Hideaway, The Residence) and the Fandom page links "Secrets of the Maw", but nothing in the Steam data ties achievements to them, so there is no DLC chapter. StrategyWiki has no page under "Little Nightmares". On littlenightmares.fandom.com, "Little Nightmares" is a franchise page with 19 links; "Little Nightmares (video game)" has about 47 linked pages and was used; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
